cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: Features luxurious seating appointments and offers room for the entire crew. Equipped with an ergonomically-designed helm station featuring a fiberglass dash with upholstered visor, medallion digital instruments, Bluetooth stereo, and power assisted tilt steering; this boat is a captain’s delight!

what_is_included_items.value: Max of 10 passengers including children (not to exceed 1700lbs)
Must be 18+ to rent and drive

what_to_bring: Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.
